---
title: "Pna scRNA-seq FeaturePlot and DotPlot"
author: "Tosuke"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Load Seurat object

```{r load}
obj <- readRDS("/mnt/data/tosuke/R/scRNAseq_Pn/github/Pna_UMAP.rds")
ncol(obj) # No. of cells
nrow(obj) # No. of genes
```

## Set cell-type identities

```{r idents, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
Idents(obj) <- "cell_type"

levels(obj) <- c(
  "Digestive",
  "Endoderm-like I",
  "Endoderm-like II and III",
  "Endodermal progenitor",
  "Stem cells",
  "Cilia related",
  "Epithelial",
  "Muscle",
  "Neurons",
  "Sensory neurons",
  "TRP+ neurons",
  "Secretory cells",
  "Unknown"
)

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 1) + NoLegend()
```

## Genes of interest

```{r genes}
genes <- c("g37041", "g29952")
```

## FeaturePlot

```{r featureplot, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5}
FeaturePlot(
  object = obj,
  features = genes,
  reduction = "umap",
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE
) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```

## DotPlot

```{r dotplot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6}
DotPlot(
  object = obj,
  features = genes
) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12)
  )
```
